from calendar_core.slots import Event, free_slots, overlaps, parse_time, fmt_duration


def test_issue_unsorted_disjoint():
    """Events may arrive in any order."""
    result = free_slots([Event(720, 780), Event(540, 600)], 480, 1020)
    # 540-480=60, 720-600=120, 1020-780=240
    assert result == [(480, 540), (600, 720), (780, 1020)]


def test_issue_overlapping_merged():
    """Events may overlap each other."""
    result = free_slots([Event(540, 700), Event(600, 650)], 480, 800)
    # 540-480=60 merged 540-700, 800-700=100
    assert result == [(480, 540), (700, 800)]


def test_issue_unsorted_overlapping_chain():
    """Events may arrive in any order and may overlap each other."""
    result = free_slots([Event(600, 700), Event(500, 620), Event(650, 750)], 480, 800)
    # merged 500-750; 500-480=20, 800-750=50
    assert result == [(480, 500), (750, 800)]


def test_issue_clip_before_day():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped to it."""
    result = free_slots([Event(400, 550)], 480, 1020)
    # clipped to 480-550; 1020-550=470
    assert result == [(550, 1020)]


def test_issue_clip_after_day():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped to it."""
    result = free_slots([Event(900, 1100)], 480, 1020)
    # clipped to 900-1020; 900-480=420
    assert result == [(480, 900)]


def test_issue_ignore_outside():
    """Events entirely outside the day are ignored."""
    result = free_slots([Event(0, 100), Event(1100, 1200)], 480, 1020)
    # 1020-480=540 whole day free
    assert result == [(480, 1020)]


def test_issue_min_minutes_filters():
    """Only gaps of at least min_minutes are returned."""
    result = free_slots([Event(540, 600), Event(610, 700)], 480, 800, min_minutes=30)
    # 540-480=60 keep, 610-600=10 drop, 800-700=100 keep
    assert result == [(480, 540), (700, 800)]


def test_issue_min_minutes_boundary():
    """Only gaps of at least min_minutes are returned."""
    result = free_slots([Event(10, 20), Event(29, 40)], 0, 60, min_minutes=10)
    # 10-0=10 keep (exact), 29-20=9 drop (just below), 60-40=20 keep
    assert result == [(0, 10), (40, 60)]


def test_issue_empty_events():
    """Gaps inside [day_start, day_end) not covered by any event."""
    result = free_slots([], 480, 1020)
    # 1020-480=540 whole day free
    assert result == [(480, 1020)]


def test_contract_back_to_back_no_gap():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    result = free_slots([Event(540, 600), Event(600, 660)], 480, 720)
    # 540-480=60, 660-600=0 no gap, 720-660=60
    assert result == [(480, 540), (660, 720)]


def test_contract_overlaps_back_to_back():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    # shared minutes = 0, so False
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 600), Event(600, 660)) is False


def test_contract_parse_time():
    """parse_time turns HH:MM (24-hour) into minutes."""
    # 8*60+30=510
    assert parse_time("08:30") == 510


def test_contract_fmt_duration():
    """fmt_duration renders Xh YYm (e.g. 65 -> 1h 05m)."""
    # 65=60+5 -> 1h 05m
    assert fmt_duration(65) == "1h 05m"
